name: resource-explorer-frontend-build
description: Build step for bundled (non-CDN) frontend assets — Tailwind CSS plus vendored marked/plotly.js/svg-pan-zoom — for the UI under resource_explorer/web/static/next (Tailwind entry: tailwind-next.config.js). Mermaid renders server-side via Kroki instead (see diagrams.py), so it isn't vendored here.

scripts.build: npm run build:css:next && npm run build:vendor
